ads.name: The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair, London

name: The Connaught
description:
Dating from 1897, this renowned luxury hotel in Mayfair is an 8-minute walk from posh shops on Bond Street and 7 minutes' walk from Bond Street tube station.
Serene rooms with marble bathrooms and luxe linens offer flat-screen TVs, free Wi-Fi and butler service. Airy suites add sitting areas, original art and Bose systems. Plush upgraded suites include 4-poster beds, terraces and/or custom sculptures. An apartment has a kitchen and a wraparound balcony.
Amenities include an acclaimed French restaurant, a glass-enclosed brasserie, a chic cocktail bar and a champagne room. There's also an elegant spa with a steam room, an indoor pool and a gym.
address: The Connaught, Carlos Pl, London W1K 2AL, United Kingdom

user_review.comment: My son kindly bought me a voucher for Afternoon Tea at Christmas and we used it last week.  I love to go around the different 5* hotels trying out the Afternoon Tea and this one didn't disappoint. ||We were warmly greeted straight upon arrival, given a choice of table to sit at which means alot to me as i suffer with anxiety.  We were explained about the different options we could choose and the food was really nice, great variety and all delicious.  The service was excellent.||The only little thing i could say is that there was no tablecloth and all the 5* hotels we have been too there are tablecloths on the tables which i always think look nicer  and the room wasn't decorated as nicely as some other hotels we have been too.||Saying that it was excellent value for money and would love to return.
